name: Moncks Corner (United States)
description: Dark blue field with a white crescent in the upper hoist and a white live oak at the fly, over bands of green, light blue and blue along the bottom for the land and waters.
history: Moncks Corner is the county seat of Berkeley County, South Carolina. Flags of the World records the design from the town's website, noting that photographs show the flag flown without text.

features.role: bands of green, light blue and blue along the bottom
